items.item: (2) F1 persistence is not yet an order
items.how: 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation: argued, since what does not hold it ceases' gone from every dossier. PHILOSOPHY front, P-04, A-16, BUDDHIST Terms and B-24 now say: a life goes on through what sustains it, going on is not yet an order over courses (a stone goes on and ranks nothing); where a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses, that order is self-concern, a hypothesis in the proofs, and that a life forms such an order is argued, not shown. P-16's question 1 kept as F1's question, its lead-in re-said to what 07 now says ('Does any argument carry from persisting to an order ...?'); P-04 adds a [this dossier, AI] weakness: this dossier finds in 07 no argument carrying a life from going on to an order, so 'argued, not shown' marks where one is owed. 'What we ask' item 2 now asks that first.

Wherever a dossier equates the condition with «续无外» or closure it now says the reading: PHILOSOPHY front ('Read on relations, with significance from a standpoint taken as what lies within its center's closure along a chosen relation (a reading, P-03)'), P-03 (the thesis 'calls it a reading', 07 §1 linked), P-17 ('Read on relations ... (a reading, P-03), and held de se'), A-16's 'Under the condition' bullet, LOGIC's name table row for «续无外» ('the continuation condition, read on relations and held de se'), BUDDHIST Terms ('若把意义读作位于一个中心沿某一所选关系的闭包之内（这是一种读法）'); B-24 and L-23 already said 'read'.

'not yet stated as one theorem' for mutual dependence to the condition gone. PHILOSOPHY front: 'Read along being affected, the condition holds where relations close, read without time: mutual dependence ... gives it near-definitionally, for significance bounded by each center's reach (05); the route from there to the ranking between level paths is not stated as one theorem'; A-16 the same with `Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`; P-16 quotes 07's two sentences (proved and near-definitional; what is not one theorem). The acyclic one-center result kept beside it ('as among dated occurrences'). `Flow.returning_unrestricted_iff_mutuallyDependent` not cited.

'between listed courses', 'ranks listed courses as C does', 'on a listing ... ranks as C does' gone from the dossiers. The front says the finite-listing result and the path result with its restriction: 'on a finite listing and between two level paths whose admissions fit in a finite list, so that both admit nothing from some step on; for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown'; P-16 and A-16 put `Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed` beside `Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`; the downstream route says 'a self-concerned order is increasing in admission' on that listing (front, P-20). 'What is not claimed' now names where self-concern does not rank every widening: a listed item not its own (some self-concerned order then does not, `increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_marks`), and courses forming without end. 'One way' kept wherever the path theorem is said; nowhere is the order said to be C or unique.

items.item: (2) F5 no authority outside becoming, at its reach
items.how: The fifth pass's 'since no should stands beyond becoming, there is no warrant binding every mind to find, and the ethics does not wait on one' (PHILOSOPHY front) is now: 'The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one, argued on the thesis of one relational unfolding (07). That neither the represented dynamics nor logic alone force the condition is proved (P-01, P-11). Whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle; how scope and order form within becoming is its open target (08 §12, item 12).' ALIGNMENT's 'What is not claimed' and BUDDHIST B-34 say the non-forcing as proved, of the represented dynamics with significance free.

items.item: (2) F6 seeing is needed, and not enough
items.how: 'A center whose seeing stops at its own closure ranks more narrowly; that is a matter of reach' gone. PHILOSOPHY front: 'A center's couplings limit what its selection can respond to, the gap alignment works on (P-25), and reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses by it are separate relations: seeing more is needed, and not enough'; one way said as 'concern for one's own continuation does not reach those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance, argued and deniable without contradiction' (front, A-16, BUDDHIST Terms). P-25 quotes 07's new 'Reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses by it are separate relations, so a narrower ranking or a disagreement is not only a failure of reach.'

F7: no dossier interprets 'a clarified ethics, not a grounded one'; SCIENCES' 'the ethics with scope and order apart' (its paraphrase of 08 §8's three new things) is now 'the clarified ethics'. F8: P-26 adds 07's 'That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.' No other dossier describes T8's test.

C no longer stands as 'order' beside the condition in any dossier's own voice. Widening is said once per front as what every positive weighting ranks higher, no second premise; C as 'an order ranking a course above every course it widens (`Comparison`)', used where a theorem takes it (PHILOSOPHY front and Terms, P-07, A-16, ALIGNMENT Terms, LOGIC L-23/L-24, SCIENCES Terms, BUDDHIST Terms, C-17, C-24, CODEBOOK). Where the dossiers had said C in place of widening (P-05, P-07's weakness and questions, P-21, P-22, P-23, P-24) they now say widening or 'an order ranking by widening (C)'; P-24's 'never ranked above it by C' is now 'C (`Comparison`) never asks that it be ranked above', as 07's table says (E8). Titles: P-04 'How far concern reaches, and how it ranks courses' (07 §4's heading), P-07 'Widening, what every positive weighting ranks higher', A-16 as P-04; anchors kept (p-04-how-scope-and-order-emerge-together-from-continuation, p-07-c-widening, a-16-scope-and-order-from-continuation added beside the earlier kept slugs); the items list and response forms follow. P-04 records C's history from 07's dated note; A-16's dated weakness notes kept as written, with one dated line added for the withdrawal. Chinese: '定范围 ... 定次序' and 'C 即扩大' gone; 伦理出自延续 -> 伦理从延续中生出 (as the fronts, Fable's fifth-pass note on 出自 as 'derived from'). Formal uses of C (with no C, as C asks there, `ReadsNoOrder`, the menu witness, quotes of 07) kept.

Now: 'a reason binding every mind to hold the continuation condition or an order ranking by widening: the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one (argued, on the thesis of one relational unfolding); with significance free, the represented dynamics do not force the condition, and it can be denied without contradiction (proved); whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle, and the target kept is how scope and order form within becoming (07; 08 §12, item 12).'
